bio: Ligonier Updates is the official news and content platform of Ligonier Ministries, dedicated to equipping Christians with Reformed theological resources and biblical teaching. Through articles, updates, and curated content, Ligonier Updates serves the global church by promoting the study of Scripture and classical Christian doctrine.

name: Ian J. Vaillancourt
bio: Ian J. Vaillancourt is a biblical scholar and writer for The Gospel Coalition who specializes in Old Testament wisdom literature. His work explores how the Psalms, Proverbs, and the wisdom books of Scripture speak to the full range of human experience and point readers toward Christ.

name: Gene Edward Veith
bio: Gene Edward Veith Jr. is professor of literature at Patrick Henry College and a contributing editor at World Magazine and Ligonier Ministries. One of evangelical Christianity's leading voices on culture and the arts, he is the author of numerous books including Postmodern Times, State of the Arts, and God at Work: Your Christian Vocation in All of Life. He writes from a confessional Lutheran perspective on everything from classical education to contemporary media.
affiliation: Patrick Henry College / World Magazine / Ligonier Ministries
education: PhD in English, University of Kansas

name: Rob Ventura
bio: Rob Ventura (MDiv, Reformed Baptist Seminary) is one of the pastors of Grace Community Baptist Church in North Providence, Rhode Island. A former Hip Hop promoter turned preacher, he brings unconventional background to evangelical ministry and has contributed to Reformation 21 magazine and biblical scholarship works.
education: Master of Divinity, Reformed Baptist Seminary

books.title: Equipped to Evangelize: A Biblical Foundation
Expository Outlines and Observations on Romans

name: Guy Prentiss Waters
bio: Guy Prentiss Waters is a Reformed theologian and pastor known for his accessible yet scholarly writings on biblical theology and Christian living. He has served in pastoral ministry and has been a prolific author and teacher, helping evangelical Christians understand the depth of Scripture through a Reformed lens.
affiliation: Ligonier Ministries, Reformed Presbyterian Church of North America

books.title: How Jesus Fulfills the Old Testament
Justification and the New Perspective on Paul

name: Trevin Wax
bio: Trevin Wax is Vice President of Research and Resource Development at The Gospel Coalition and author of numerous books on Christian faith and practice. He represents evangelical congregationalism, advocating that Scripture supports member participation in church decisions and democratic governance structures. Wax argues that congregational input on pastoral selection, church discipline, and major decisions reflects biblical values of member ownership and accountability.
education: Wheaton College (BA); Southern Baptist Theological Seminary (MDiv)

name: Ed Welch
bio: Edward T. Welch is a senior faculty member at CCEF and a licensed psychologist whose writing has helped shape evangelical thinking on addiction, depression, anxiety, and shame. His book Addictions: A Banquet in the Grave reframed addiction as a worship disorder of the heart, grounding recovery in the gospel and the ordinary ministry of the local church.
education: University of Utah (PhD, Counseling Psychology); Biblical Theological Seminary (MDiv)

books.title: Addictions: A Banquet in the Grave
When People Are Big and God Is Small

name: Alexandra Wexler
bio: Reporter at The Wall Street Journal covering emerging markets, global finance, and international affairs with focus on Africa. Based in Johannesburg.

name: Laura Wifler
bio: Laura Wifler is a bestselling author of children's and adult books exploring the intersection of faith and everyday life. Co-founder of Risen Motherhood and founder of The KidLit Lab, she is a beloved voice for Christian mothers and aspiring writers.

books.title: Any Time, Any Place, Any Prayer

name: Jen Wilkin
bio: Jen Wilkin is an author, speaker, and Bible teacher known for her work in biblical literacy and women's discipleship. She has written numerous books including Women of the Word and In His Image, and developed influential Bible study curricula emphasizing direct Scripture engagement and interpretive skills. A leading voice in systematic biblical instruction within evangelicalism, she advocates for teaching people how to read and understand Scripture carefully.
education: Baylor University (MA, Biblical Studies); Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary

name: Dallas Willard
bio: Dallas Willard (1935-2013) was a philosopher and spiritual director whose theology emphasized spiritual formation and renovated heart transformation. His later writings reflected on life, death, and eternity with philosophical precision and spiritual depth. Willard's understanding of the kingdom of God and eternal life offers evangelical resources for facing mortality with perspective on God's eternal purposes.
education: University of Oklahoma (BA); Southern Baptist Seminary (BD); University of Wisconsin (MA, PhD)

name: Daniel K. Williams
bio: Daniel K. Williams is a historian at Ashland University specializing in American religion and politics, the Christian Right, and the pro-life movement. His scholarly works examine the intersection of faith and American political history.

name: Nadya Williams
bio: Nadya Williams is a classicist and historian who left academia to write about ancient Christianity and classical literature from a Christian perspective. Books Editor at Mere Orthodoxy, she is the author of Cultural Christians in the Early Church and other works on the ancient world.

books.title: Cultural Christians in the Early Church
Mothers, Children, and the Body Politic

name: Kyle Worley
bio: Kyle Worley is the lead pastor of Mosaic Church in Richardson, Texas, and co-host of the Knowing Faith podcast with J. T. English and Jen Wilkin. An author and teacher with over twenty years in ministry, he writes on union with Christ and the theological formation of local churches.

name: Paul Christopher
bio: Paul Christopher is a Christian author and thought leader who writes on faith, culture, and spiritual discipleship. His work encourages believers to engage thoughtfully with contemporary issues through a biblical worldview.

name: Samuel D. James
bio: Samuel D. James is a writer and editor known for thoughtful commentary on faith, culture, and technology from a Christian perspective. He has contributed to leading evangelical publications and is recognized for helping Christians think biblically about contemporary cultural issues.

name: O. Alan Noble
bio: O. Alan Noble is a writer and editor focused on Christian engagement with culture, technology, and faith. He has written extensively on how Christians can think critically about media, entertainment, and digital life while remaining grounded in biblical wisdom. Noble's work encourages believers to develop a thoughtful, redemptive perspective on contemporary culture.
education: MA in English Literature, University of Nebraska

books.title: Disruptive Witness: Speaking Truth in a Fragmented World
You Are Not Your Own: Belonging to God in an Inhuman World
Conscience: Three Generations of Abortion, Family, and Tradition

name: Aaron M. Renn
bio: Aaron M. Renn is a writer and analyst focused on Christianity's cultural and institutional place in American public life. He explores how Christian faith engages with broader cultural trends, offering thoughtful commentary on secularization, religious liberty, and the future of Christian witness in contemporary society.

books.title: The Masculinity Crisis: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why It Matters, and What to Do About It

name: Collin Hansen
bio: Collin Hansen is a respected evangelical author and editor known for his work on church history, theology, and contemporary Christian issues. As editorial director for The Gospel Coalition, he has helped shape conversations among Reformed and evangelical leaders worldwide. His writing combines scholarly insight with pastoral concern for the local church.

books.title: Young, Restless, Reformed: A Journalist's Journey with the New Calvinism
Blind Spots: Becoming a Courageous, Compassionate, and Commissioned Church
That's Not What I Meant: Finding Grace When Words Backfire
Redeeming Sex: Naked Conversations About Sexuality and Following Jesus
Our Secular Age: Ten Years of Reading and Applying Charles Taylor

name: Kathy Keller
bio: Kathy Keller is a writer, speaker, and co-founder of Redeemer City to City, an organization dedicated to planting and strengthening churches in global cities. She has written extensively on faith, marriage, and Christian living, drawing from her decades of experience in ministry alongside her husband, Timothy Keller. Her work encourages Christians to live out their faith authentically in contemporary culture.
affiliation: Redeemer City to City, The Gospel Coalition

books.title: The Meaning of Marriage: Facing the Complexities of Commitment with the Wisdom of God
Jesus the King: Understanding the Life and Death of the Son of God
God's Loving Plan: Experiencing the Gospel in Work, Relationships, and Even Loss

name: Damien Cave
bio: Damien Cave is an accomplished journalist and correspondent known for his investigative reporting and in-depth coverage of complex social and political issues. His work has appeared in major national publications where he has brought thoughtful analysis and human-centered storytelling to contemporary challenges.

name: Chris Martin
bio: Chris Martin is a worship leader, songwriter, and pastor known for his contributions to contemporary Christian music and spiritual leadership. He has dedicated his ministry to helping believers engage with God through authentic worship and biblical teaching.

name: Zia ur-Rehman and Asim Hafeez
bio: Zia ur-Rehman and Asim Hafeez are Pakistani journalists and documentarians known for their investigative work covering conflict, terrorism, and security issues in South Asia. While not primarily Christian content creators, their reporting has provided important context on religious extremism and persecution for international audiences seeking to understand global challenges.

name: J. A. Medders
bio: J. A. Medders is a writer and pastor dedicated to helping Christians understand and live out their faith with greater depth and authenticity. His work focuses on biblical discipleship, spiritual growth, and the practical application of Scripture to everyday life.

books.title: Sola Scriptura: What the Bible Says About Itself
The Expository Preacher: How to Preach the Whole Bible

name: Stephen Kalin
bio: Stephen Kalin is a researcher and analyst specializing in Middle Eastern politics and religious affairs. His work examines the intersection of faith, geopolitics, and international relations, with particular focus on how religious identity shapes political outcomes in the region.

name: Joseph Sherrard
bio: Joseph Sherrard is a Christian writer and content creator focused on biblical teaching and spiritual formation. His work encourages believers to deepen their understanding of Scripture and apply biblical principles to daily life.

name: R.C. Sproul
bio: R.C. Sproul was a highly influential Reformed theologian, pastor, and prolific author who dedicated his life to making complex theological concepts accessible to everyday Christians. He founded Ligonier Ministries and was known for his passionate teaching on the holiness of God, biblical Reformed theology, and the sovereignty of God. Through his books, radio program, and teaching ministry, Sproul shaped the spiritual lives of countless believers worldwide.
education: M.Div., Westminster Theological Seminary; Ph.D., Free University of Amsterdam

books.title: Essential Truths of the Christian Faith

name: Joshua Heavin
bio: Joshua Heavin is a writer and Christian communicator dedicated to exploring faith, culture, and discipleship. His work focuses on helping believers think deeply about their relationship with God and the world around them.

name: Taigen Joos
bio: Taigen Joos is a Christian writer and contemplative theologian exploring the intersection of Buddhist-Christian dialogue and contemplative spirituality. His work engages readers in deepening their faith through meditative practices and interfaith understanding rooted in Christian tradition.

name: Lauren Groves
bio: Lauren Groves is a Christian author and speaker known for her work in faith-based content creation and spiritual encouragement. She has built a platform focused on helping believers deepen their relationship with God through authentic and practical Christian living.

name: Allen D. Hertzke
bio: Allen D. Hertzke is a distinguished political scientist and scholar who has written extensively on the intersection of religion and politics in American public life. His research examines how faith communities engage with political institutions and shape policy on issues ranging from religious freedom to human rights advocacy.

books.title: Representing God in Washington: Religious Interest Groups and the American Political System
Freeing God's Children: The Unlikelihood of Religious Politics and the Unlikely Alliances for Religious Freedom
Faith in the Halls of Power: How Evangelicals Joined the American Elite

name: Chad Van Dixhoorn
bio: Chad Van Dixhoorn is a Reformed theologian and scholar known for his extensive work on the Westminster Standards and historical theology. He serves as a professor and has dedicated much of his career to making classical Reformed theology accessible to contemporary Christians.

books.title: Confessing the Faith: A Reader's Guide to the Westminster Confession of Faith
The Covenant Renewed: A Reader's Guide to the Shorter Catechism
The Living Christ: An Exposition of Hebrews

name: Anne Kerhoulas
bio: Anne Kerhoulas is a Christian author and speaker who writes about faith, family, and spiritual growth. Her work encourages believers to deepen their relationship with God through practical wisdom and scriptural insight.

name: Emily Belz
bio: Emily Belz is a journalist and editor known for her reporting on religious freedom, international affairs, and the intersection of faith and public life. She has contributed extensively to evangelical publications and brings a thoughtful, nuanced perspective to contemporary issues facing the Christian community.

name: Uwa Ede-Osifo
bio: Uwa Ede-Osifo is a Nigerian Christian writer and communicator passionate about faith, culture, and discipleship. Through his writing and speaking, he engages thoughtfully with contemporary issues from a biblical worldview, seeking to help believers navigate their faith in the modern world.

name: David M. Halbfinger
bio: David M. Halbfinger is a veteran journalist and media analyst who has served as executive editor and chief political correspondent for major American news organizations. With decades of experience covering politics, culture, and faith-related issues, he brings thoughtful analysis to contemporary issues of interest to Christian readers and faith communities.

name: Natalie Andrews
bio: Natalie Andrews is a Christian writer and content creator dedicated to exploring faith, discipleship, and spiritual growth. Through her writing and speaking, she encourages believers to deepen their relationship with Christ and live out their faith authentically in everyday life.

name: Robert VanDoodewaard
bio: Robert VanDoodewaard is a pastor and Christian author known for his work on biblical theology and historical Christian thought. He has written extensively on topics including idolatry, the sufficiency of Scripture, and the practical application of Reformed theology to contemporary Christian life.

books.title: The Headcovering: A Study of the Biblical Basis and Application of Headcovering
Idols of the Heart: Learning to Long for God Alone
What Does the Bible Really Teach about Homosexuality

name: A PCA Ruling Elder
bio: A PCA Ruling Elder serves as a lay leader in the Presbyterian Church in America, devoted to faithful church governance and spiritual oversight. Ruling Elders work alongside pastoral staff to shepherd their congregations with biblical wisdom and pastoral care.

name: Haley Byrd Wilt
bio: Haley Byrd Wilt is a writer and editor known for her work in Christian publishing and content creation. She has contributed to various Christian publications and platforms, bringing thoughtful perspectives on faith, culture, and discipleship to evangelical audiences.

name: Stu Escalona
bio: Stu Escalona is a pastor and Christian communicator dedicated to helping believers grow in their faith and understanding of Scripture. Through teaching and writing, he seeks to make biblical truths accessible and applicable to everyday Christian living.

name: Malcolm Guite
bio: Malcolm Guite is a poet, priest, and scholar who serves as Chaplain of Girton College, Cambridge. He is known for his contemporary sonnets, theological reflections, and work in Christian apologetics and the integration of faith with literature and the arts. His writing draws on both classical Christian tradition and modern sensibilities to help readers encounter God's presence in beauty, nature, and everyday life.
affiliation: Girton College, Cambridge; The Christian Institute

name: Andy Olsen
bio: Andy Olsen is a thoughtful voice in Christian ministry and content creation. He brings practical wisdom and biblical insight to contemporary faith discussions.

name: Erika Solomon
bio: Erika Solomon is a Reuters correspondent and journalist known for her investigative reporting on Middle Eastern affairs, international politics, and religious dynamics in global contexts. Her work frequently examines complex geopolitical issues with nuance and depth.

name: Ashley Ahn
bio: Ashley Ahn is a writer and content creator who engages Christian audiences with thoughtful perspectives on faith, culture, and discipleship. Her work encourages believers to deepen their understanding of Scripture and live out their faith authentically in today's world.
